entities.summary: Duke Riley is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the LSU Tigers and was selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the third round of the 2017 NFL draft. Riley has also played for the Philadelphia Eagles, Miami Dolphins, and Washington Commanders.
